headline: Puerto Rico rations water as intense drought strains supplies
summary: Hot weather, ageing infrastructure and intense drought are forcing water rationing across Puerto Rico, affecting hundreds of thousands.
script: Puerto Rico is rationing water as intense drought, hot weather and ageing infrastructure squeeze supplies. The measures affect hundreds of thousands of people, turning a climate problem into a daily public-utility crisis.
